text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data instead of following strict rules. One common type is supervised learning, where the computer uses training data—examples that already have the correct answers—to build a model. For instance, you might show a model thousands of photos labeled “cat” or “dog.” The model looks for patterns, such as shapes or colors, and adjusts itself to recognize those patterns. Once trained, it can make predictions on new, unseen photos. To check how well it works, we test its accuracy, which tells us the percentage of correct predictions. The goal is to make the model as accurate as possible.
